svg.text: ELEVATION NOTES: 1. ALL EXTERIOR MATERIALS + COLORS ARE LEARNING SELECTIONS. 2. KEEP SIDING + WOOD 8" MIN. ABOVE FINISH GRADE. 3. LEVELS REFER TO PROJECT DATUM T.O. SLAB = 100'-0". 4. FLASH ALL OPENINGS SHINGLE-FASHION PER A501.
VERIFY WITH A LICENSED PROFESSIONAL + THE AHJ
DRAWUP TYPICAL LEARNING CONTENT · NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION · EVERY VIEW ON EVERY SHEET IS CUT FROM ONE BUILDING MODEL, SO TAGS, DIMENSIONS + LEVELS AGREE ACROSS THE SET.
